course.title: Agentic AI System Design: From Prompt to Production
course.description: Build, evaluate, secure, scale, and explain production-grade AI agent systems.

modules.title: How to Design an Agentic System
modules.build: Create the first Atlas design canvas and risk profile.

modules.title: Should This Be an Agent?
modules.build: Write an agent-versus-workflow decision memo for Atlas.

modules.title: The Agent Loop and Its Control Boundaries
modules.build: Implement a bounded tool-calling loop with typed state and stop conditions.

modules.title: Tool Contracts, Side Effects, and the Acknowledgment Gap
modules.build: Add typed, risk-rated tools with idempotency and error semantics.

modules.title: Context Engineering, Retrieval, and Grounding
modules.build: Build an ACL-aware context assembler with provenance and citations.

modules.title: State, Sessions, and Memory
modules.build: Separate run state, thread state, and governed long-term memory.

modules.title: Orchestration Patterns and State Machines
modules.build: Convert Atlas into an explicit graph with routing, parallel work, and join conditions.

modules.title: Durable and Long-Running Agents
modules.build: Make Atlas survive crashes, waits, retries, and deploys without repeating unsafe effects.

modules.title: Human-in-the-Loop and Bounded Authority
modules.build: Add a durable approval queue with approve, edit, reject, and escalation paths.

modules.title: Multi-Agent Design, MCP, and A2A
modules.build: Expose one Atlas capability through MCP and evaluate whether an A2A boundary is justified.

modules.title: Security, Identity, Isolation, and Governance
modules.build: Threat-model Atlas and add policy enforcement, tenant isolation, and adversarial tests.

modules.title: Agent Evaluation and Testing
modules.build: Create a regression dataset and score components, trajectories, outcomes, and safety.

modules.title: Observability, SLOs, and Incident Response
modules.build: Instrument Atlas traces, metrics, logs, dashboards, and an incident replay workflow.

modules.title: Latency, Cost, Throughput, and Scale
modules.build: Load-test Atlas and introduce routing, caching, queues, backpressure, and cost budgets.

modules.title: Deployment, Change Management, and Enterprise Readiness
modules.build: Ship a versioned canary release with rollback, data controls, and operational ownership.

modules.title: The 45-Minute Agentic System-Design Interview
modules.build: Deliver and self-score a complete Atlas system-design answer.

modules.title: Capstone: Atlas in Production
modules.build: Build, demo, evaluate, and defend the complete production system.
